name: Bubble Wrap Royale
promptTemplate: Giant wall of bubble wrap in {{bubble_style}} style with {{bubble_columns}} columns, running in {{speed_mode}} tempo with beat-popping {{beat_pops}}.

ui.title: BUBBLE ROYALE +6
ui.tagline: MASH TO POP IN YOUR COLOUR AND CLAIM THE WALL

pop.hint: Pop a random bubble in your hue

bubble_columns.hint: Adjust bubble size and grid count

beat_pops.hint: Heavy bass kicks burst bubbles automatically

listing.blurb: A giant sheet of translucent bubble wrap covers the wall as players race to pop every bubble in their personal colour, crowned by a winner banner before the next fresh sheet unrolls.
listing.prompt: A giant sheet of bubble wrap covering the wall: every press of 'pop' pops one bubble at random with a satisfying burst in your colour; the person who popped the most wins when the sheet is done, and a fresh sheet unrolls from the top. Make it a party game a whole room can follow from across the floor: bold shapes and bright colours on a dark ground, every player drawn in their own hue, big short labels (a score, GO!, the winner) in a heavy font, and a large, satisfying reaction on screen the instant anyone presses. It must work with one player or forty, scaling its lanes, seats or pieces to room.people and coping with people joining and leaving mid-round; play itself in a lively attract mode whenever nobody has pressed anything for a few seconds; and after a winner is shown, start the next round on its own. Keep it lean: game state in bounded arrays in room.state, nothing allocated inside hot loops, a steady 60fps at 1920x1080.
